questions.text: Sloka Inc. is considering two different projects, A and B, for investment and can choose at most one project to invest in. Project A costs Rs 10,000 and is expected to generate Rs 5,000 in year one and Rs 7,000 in year two. Project B costs Rs 12,000 and is expected to generate Rs 8,000 in year one, Rs 4,000 in year two, Rs 2,000 in year three, and Rs 1,000 in year four. Sloka Inc.’s required rate of return for these projects is 5%. Which of the following is true?
options: Sloka Inc. should prefer Project B as it has a higher net present value than Project A.
Sloka Inc. should prefer Project A as it has a higher net present value than Project B.
Sloka Inc. is indifferent between Project A and Project B as both have the same net present value.
Sloka Inc. should not invest in either projects A or B as both have negative net present value.
questions.correct_answer: Sloka Inc. should prefer Project B as it has a higher net present value than Project A.

questions.text: Consider a put option and a call option with the same strike price and time to maturity. Which of the following is FALSE?
